question: Using the sales data, what is the median value of total sales made in countries where the number of customers is greater than 4?
sql:
WITH customer_counts AS (
    SELECT Country, COUNT(*) as num_customers
    FROM customers
    GROUP BY Country
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 4
),
country_sales AS (
    SELECT c.Country, SUM(i.Total) as total_sales
    FROM customers c
    JOIN invoices i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId
    GROUP BY c.Country
)
SELECT ROUND(MEDIAN(cs.total_sales), 2) as median_total_sales
FROM country_sales cs
JOIN customer_counts cc ON cs.Country = cc.Country;
